review.notes: The pull request changes this folder by one five-line README bullet (Beside — PlanarTopology); Suggested.lean is identical to main. Gate at this head: FAIL on prnum=4, sorry-examples=6, target-ids=1, all pre-existing on main (R03-R05, P3); build passes (6 sorry warnings, 3.8 s); depcheck 0 problems, 1163 edges (same as main, the bullet adds no edge). R01 (P2): the bullet says Carathéodory takes IsJordanDomain and IsSimplyConnected of hJ.inside and that PlanarTopology layer 7 supplies the latter; at the pin TauCeti.exists_homeomorph_closedBall_closure_of_isJordanCurve_frontier (Jordan/Approach.lean:213) takes only open, connected, bounded, Jordan frontier, and IsJordanDomain.isSimplyConnected (Jordan/Domain.lean:226) already derives simple connectivity. R02 (P3): the bullet assigns Brouwer, separation, invariance of domain and Schoenflies to PlanarTopology although AlgebraicTopology on main (Stage 2 item 7) owns Brouwer and the two-component count on S^2 and arc non-separation are at the pin; and it reads as a supplier citation of a completed roadmap. R06 (P3): stale library claims (Mathlib has Morera for a disk; RiemannMapping.lean lemmas are public; L5/L6 are proved at the pinned Tau Ceti, not unstatable). Adversarial table: 12 rows with computed values; six Suggested.lean statements sound; one-tactic padding probe negative. Sources: textbooks cited by chapter only, no locators to sample; none verifiable legally.
